scripts.worker:docker:push: aws ecr get-login-password --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 | docker login -u AWS --password-stdin 127.0.0.1:5100 && docker push 127.0.0.1:5100/docflow-worker:latest && docker tag 127.0.0.1:5100/docflow-worker:latest 000000000000.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.localhost:5100/docflow-worker:latest
scripts.worker:docker:deploy: aws ecs update-service --cluster docflow --service docflow-worker --desired-count 0 --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 && C=$(aws ecs describe-services --cluster docflow --services docflow-worker --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --query 'services[0].runningCount' --output text); for i in $(seq 1 60); do [ "$C" = "0" ] && break; sleep 5; C=$(aws ecs describe-services --cluster docflow --services docflow-worker --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --query 'services[0].runningCount' --output text); done; [ "$C" = "0" ] || { echo 'worker did not scale down' >&2; exit 1; }; aws ecs update-service --cluster docflow --service docflow-worker --desired-count 1 --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 && C=$(aws ecs describe-services --cluster docflow --services docflow-worker --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --query 'services[0].runningCount' --output text); for i in $(seq 1 60); do [ "$C" = "1" ] && break; sleep 5; C=$(aws ecs describe-services --cluster docflow --services docflow-worker --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --query 'services[0].runningCount' --output text); done; [ "$C" = "1" ] || { echo 'worker did not scale up' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.worker:docker:up: pnpm worker:docker:build && pnpm worker:docker:push && pnpm worker:docker:deploy
scripts.worker:docker:status: aws ecs describe-services --cluster docflow --services docflow-worker --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566
